title.zh: 开源Hermes Agent下载2270万次，Nous Research融资9000万美元做企业生意
title.en: 开源Hermes Agent下载2270万次，Nous Research融资9000万美元做企业生意

current_state.zh: Nous Research closed a $90M Series B at a $1.5B valuation led by Robot Ventures with Nvidia, Microsoft M12, Samsung and USV participating, to push its open-source Hermes agent—downloaded 22.7M times and running at about $36M annualized revenue—into the enterprise market with SSO, permissions, audit and workspace-isolation features while keeping the agent free under MIT license.
